2608.04804.title: Scrouting: Cost-Aware Routing of Coding Agents by Scouting the Repository First
2608.04804.paper_summary: Frontier language models can resolve repository-level software issues, but each attempt is expensive, and existing routers select a model from the issue text alone. We present SuperScout, which routes after scouting the repository: a 7B searcher, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff whose reproduction claims are sandbox-verified, with false claims stripped before delivery. The searcher's hidden states, together with the task text, then feed a resume-based router that dispatches the task to one of four frontier fixers. Adding a new fixer requires no retraining. On the full Python slice of SWE-bench Pro (266 tasks) under the benchmark's official capped budget tier, SuperScout matches the best single model's solve rate (159 of 266 for SuperScout, 158 for the best model) at about a fifth of the total cost per solve, and the reported configuration sits above the random traffic-splitting baseline. A no-router ablation, always the cheapest fixer with the handoff, ties the routed system on this benchmark, so the handoff rather than the routing decision carries the result. A paired calibration study points to the mechanism: the handoff appears to redistribute rather than add solving ability, lifting the three cheaper fixers while slightly hurting the strongest, though at $N=99$ the per-fixer effects are directional only; the searcher's hidden states improve cost routing on the calibration labels while the handoff's own text does not. The searcher's compute adds less than half a cent of GPU time per task.
2608.04804.paper_summary_zh: 前沿語言模型可以解決庫級別的軟體問題，但每次嘗試都很昂貴，現有的路由器僅根據問題文本選擇模型。我們提出了SuperScout，它在勘查庫之後進行路由：一個7B的搜尋器，SuperScout-7B，首先探索庫並生成一個結構化的交接，其重現聲明經過沙盒驗證，並在交付前剔除虛假聲明。搜尋器的隱藏狀態，連同任務文本，然後提供給基於簡歷的路由器，該路由器將任務分派給四個前沿修復者之一。添加新的修復者不需要重新訓練。在SWE-bench Pro的完整Python切片（266個任務）中，在基準的官方上限預算層級下，SuperScout的解決率與最佳單一模型相匹配（SuperScout解決了266中的159，最佳模型解決了158），而每次解決的總成本約為最佳模型的五分之一，報告的配置高於隨機流量分配基準。一個無路由器的消融實驗，始終是與交接一起的最便宜修復者，在這個基準上與路由系統平起平坐，因此結果是由交接而非路由決策所決定。一項配對校準研究指向了這一機制：交接似乎是重新分配而非增加解決能力，提升了三個更便宜的修復者，同時稍微影響了最強的修復者，儘管在$N=99$時，每個修復者的效果僅具方向性；搜尋器的隱藏狀態改善了校準標籤上的成本路由，而交接本身的文本則沒有。搜尋器的計算每個任務增加的GPU時間不到半美分。
